notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Ayara and Carnival of Souls triggers.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
